correctness.rationale: Eliminate S and A from the positive equilibrium using S=C(1+omega I)/beta, A=q M/(p+M) S and N=(Lambda-alpha I)/d. This gives I D(M)=(Cq/beta)(kappa-M/(p+M)) and M=M0+rI/r0. If kappa<1, M stays below p*kappa/(1-kappa) and I~r0(M_infty-M0)/r. If kappa=1, multiply the two identities to yield M^2/r -> Cq p/(beta r0 D_infty) and sqrt(r)I limit. If kappa>1, lower-bound I then M->infinity and I->(C/beta)(R0-(1+q))/D_infty. Independent scalar-root and equilibrium-identity checks performed in all three regimes; existence relies on R1>1. Dynamic instability after Hopf explicitly excluded.
